Situation Report — Iran–Israel–US (last 6 hours)

  • Airspace & Travel
    • Airports in Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon and Jordan reported closed (multiple flight scans across the period).
  • Military actions
    • IDF says it killed an armed Hezbollah operative after a manhunt in southern Lebanon.
    • At least 7 Palestinians killed by Israeli forces in Gaza over the past 48 hours (report).
    • Three Palestinians reported injured by IDF amid a settler attack in a West Bank village.
    • Reuters: Israel has not identified soldiers accused of abuse; two Gaza mothers believe the missing are their sons.
  • Iran domestic & rhetoric
    • Dayslong funeral for late Supreme Leader Khamenei has begun; large crowds reported despite a heatwave.
    • Russia's Medvedev said the Strait of Hormuz is Iran’s “nuclear weapon” (rhetorical escalation).
    • Report: Iran's top negotiator says the country is ready for war while peace talks inch along.
  • Diplomacy & international moves
    • US: Trump says Netanyahu may visit the US as soon as next week.
    • TASS report: Trump says US has no intention of killing Iran’s leadership.
    • Turkey’s Erdogan urged that Israel must not be able to scuttle a US–Iran deal; commentators link this to Erdogan’s NATO posture and regional pressure on Israel.
  • Information & allegations
    • Israel officially rejects a report alleging plotting to kill Iranian negotiators (labelled “Fake News” by sources).
  • 🟢 Good News
    • Turkey publicly pushing to preserve a US–Iran deal reduces a diplomatic rupture risk.
    • Israel has publicly denied the reported plot against Iranian negotiators.

Threat assessment: escalating.
